outcome: complicated uterine rupture with urinary bladder lesion
cohort: A multiparous woman in her 30s with severe pre-eclampsia, a history of two previous Cesarean sections, and a full-term unmonitored pregnancy.
finding: This case report describes a rare and severe complication of uterine rupture, specifically umbilical cord prolapse through the urethra, in a patient with severe pre-eclampsia and a history of previous Cesarean sections, leading to fetal demise.
mod_finding: A history of two previous Cesarean sections was identified as a contributing factor to the complicated uterine rupture in this case.
